title: Check licensing of Redcode standards and warriors
lead: Find and record the licensing of the ICWS standard texts and published warriors before any of them is bundled or adapted, including whether each is compatible with pitfight's AGPL-3.0-or-later license (C32).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** bundling any warrior; the project's own license (decided in C32).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: PROJECT.md says their licensing has to be checked before bundling any existing warriors and is not verified (C14). The starter bots are original, so v1 does not wait on this.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Read public sources (read-only) for the ICWS'94 text and commonly published warriors; record the license or terms for each with a citation.
- For each item, state whether bundling it in an AGPL-3.0-or-later repository is permitted by its terms, or that the terms are unclear.
- Give the owner a bundle or do-not-bundle recommendation per item.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Every claim in the doc cites a source.
- Owner has reviewed it.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-licensing` in `.worktrees/<id>`. Document only. One commit when the owner asks.
